runs.summary: Rerun with nothing changed, 1984 comes out as it did: Reagan wins, 525–13. The closest state was Minnesota, which went to Mondale by 0.2 points. Every one of my 100 reruns reproduces it exactly.
howIGotThis: The numbers: the 1980 and 1990 census counts interpolated to 1984 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 1984 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.

women.name: Ruth Robinson
women.quote: Things have been better these last few years, haven't they? I'll probably go with the man in office. Though I wonder about all that red ink they talk about.

men.name: Ernest Reed
men.quote: Things are better now than they were a few years back. More people working, prices not climbing like they used to. I'll probably vote for him again.

questions: Election Day is Tuesday. Can this person vote, how likely are they to vote, and if they vote, for whom?
